asr.full_text: My father-in-law is a Gujarati I have the right equation with my father-in-law Just that my father-in-law is Gujarati So that means every morning He wants to debate about two hours Why is Modi Ji so amazing? Why is Modi Ji so amazing? I feel that my father-in-law would love to believe that his son-in-law is Modi I'll just trying to make people understand. Can we talk about politics? Thumbs Up everyone, can we do this? Yeah, okay, the camera is on. Oh no- I have this niece, she's 2 years old. She's very cute, She is very cute. Whenever she falls, then brother and sister-in-law, just to distract, say, look there, Look at the bird, look at the bird, they run away. They forget they got hurt, look up and run away. That's so cute, no? A.K.A. You can do a little bit for a living. But don't start fighting with everyone else. It's fine to get involved in the society itself, but not with others. When our bodies have problems, we also struggle and struggle with their problems. So even Modiji keeps doing the same with us. Whenever we ever thought, that this recession is here... and then he runs to the police station... What I love the most about Modi ji is that in his speeches he keeps addressing himself in third person. You hear his speeches you yourself repeat those people are against Modi They are afraid of Modi they are determined to kill Modi you are a good Modi and Modi-ji's pronouns are just weird they are against me, against me Yeah He thinks that Mani Manna Modi Ji thinks that he is Uncle Chaudhary that his mind is faster than a computer And Amit Shah is his boss He wants a muscular guy The image I'm about to show you is of Sabu! One needs muscles man! And there had been quite a few similarities First let's see who was Sabu's main villain? Do you know who Sabu's main villain is? Raka, Raka Sabu's main villain is Raka Here see Rahul Gandhi Raka There are so many similarities just one difference that there there was an uncle and aunt of a child that... no that's not the main issue because there is someone who is there to pull you down if there is a lot of chaos we? To press you down. You want it, don't you? Whenever you get more scams and force someone down, you want something, don't you? I think a married person could even think about demonetisation. A married person, demonetised himself, is just sleeping, and at night... He's sitting there the whole night and saying, you are sitting here on the phone... He couldn't fix his for the past 2 weeks so we decided to stay with us We can continue right? What else? Can we do a thumbs up again? We can... Earlier BJP's statement of development growth Now the government thinks, they have taken all this the public does not need all this Earlier, they used to say, I feel the entire city would grow and develop. Now they were like, well now, we don't have anything for everybody. The public doesn't need anything... BJP has two main points- Point No. 1, they are like Rahul Gandhi, stupid. Point No. 2, look at those muslims. If you say at second point, yes yes you are looking fine but you look fine they are like but Raul Nadik is a little dumb BJP is so openly anti muslim that even Shiv Sena is asking what's going on here you guys are going too far She was so openly anti-muslim that she is even asking Shiv Sena, What the hell? This is way beyond you Still, I have won a few BJP elections In the middle, people weren't losing In the middle, they were becoming an undertaker of Wrestlemania I can see that people are voting medic. In my society's RWA elections too people were trying to vote for Modi. To select the head boy in school AMESH CHA! I too thought, in Avengers Endgame Thanos will kick ass and AMESH SHA will win. But finally there were some elections that still get lost and, at the end, BJP has lost some elections. And the rest I watch TV news all year. The day BJP lost the election... I definitely watch TV news. Are Arnav, Sudhir Chaudhary, Rajesh Agrawal. It was so much fun. They go on about beating their chests. High, high. These people complain so deeply that I understand that the BJP isn't giving the money, They are just giving the linked performance money. Because normally, they'll give you X and if you win, you will get half X. So, while doing election coverage they are going inside thinking this is a holiday for Europe. Last time, it. So when you are supporting elections, then you're on European holidays? Last time when Sunit Chowkli left for Delhi Sunit Chowkli was just crazy He said Delhi people are good, bad and ignorant He almost said Delhi people are rascals And he had no idea that if he leaves Delhi Then he's quite a compliment. Someone just tell me, yeah I've been working on it! That was my resolution. Lately there's this new Modi fan, who's obsesed with her. Completely obssesed, he's been like, Modi Modi Modi Any guesses who? Angna Nicanga, is just obsessed with herself I'm talking about Imran Khan Pagal gaya obsesses ho gaya vo Modiji se Ko poora time Modi Modi Modi- Beech mein ho che Twitter profile pe gya Pichle 40 tweets to Modiji's... ...she forgot that he has a country of his own to create ...slipped out of his mind... ...and people are coming from here to take revenge for the insult... ...oh god we'll get Modiji's insult.. ...people with the watch handles... ...nope, I don't want life moves... ...was going to record this bit but forget it It had to happen You know, we would also miss a train from backwards My fate- I belive in my fate, right? Thank you Possible Favors I am confident in my own future So from here, people are coming here, to take revenge for Modi's insult with Imran Khan People with the watch and handle who are such weird what kind of insult is it to Imran Khan Imran Khan has lots of bitter exes and there are few worse ex-fries The one there is Shashi Tharoor Imran Khan has a lot of bitter exes and he has two bitter ex-wives. He is in Shashi Tharoor. And all his ones are still alive. How would you send him the one who has two bitter ex-wives. Like one of his ex-wives. I'm not making this up. True story. One of his ex-wives, in her autobi, its a true story One of his ex wife In her autobiography She's put this out That while she was still married to Imran Khan One day she entered the bedroom And Imran Khan Sleeping on the bed Was using lentils on his Testicles with lentils and she was like What are you doing? What are you doing? It's hard to see, and I saw the person lying on testicles. And she said, what are you doing? Imran Khan was like, this gives the man the power to act. Now what will you insult this man with? A person with open outer image? So he puts lentils on GoTo I mean this is the secret behind swing bowling This was meant for late river swing And if that guy was doing this to play Shoei Then it would have been whey protein I mean, how did he ever became PM? Not even Ms. Jyoti would have survived this time! It hurts to get the notes! Far superior man! Imagine, if there was a cabinet member with his family going out to get food when I went to his house for dinner the Daal would burst on the table that brother, this one really adds too much salt let's talk speak something else don't eat lentils at night Hello guys.. what is up? Few important announcements First of all, hopefully you like the video If you enjoy watching it it would be the best for me So, people who are more into life, likes, complains, and doubts are still there Secondly, I have started a new YouTube channel By the name of AlternateAbijit So, I am an obsessed cricket and soccer person So, I plan to upload lots of sports related content Thirdly, please follow me on Instagram I have weird spelling on Instagram That Instagram Since my name is some weird spelling It looks weird when it contains many follower counts So please do a good search abijit with no H in it even if you are going to send an abuse please send it on the correct account but where did it appear? And fourthly, we have started doing some shows at smaller venues taking all precautions in place There's limited seating So hopefully see you guys there Till then stay safe guys
